page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with running head at top centre and page number at top right. No marginal notes. Greek passages are set inline. A small mark at the lower right may be a gathering signature.

main_text.p: mouebantur tamen voce praeconis omnes barbari, & exesse iubebantur, quemadmodum & homicidae, aliique impij, & scelerati. Isocrates Panegyrico de Medis & Persis agens: [illegible, ~45 letters] Lucianus in Demonacte: [illegible, ~60 letters] Theon in Progymnas-matis: [illegible, ~50 letters] homicidam, [illegible, ~20 letters].

Diximus in superioribus Mysteria Cereris in initiorum sacra nullo magis quam silentio, solennia fuisse, itaque neque dicere, neque audire licebat, cum parem noxam contraherent aures, & linguae, temerariae curiositatis. Quare si quis arcanae Mysteria Cereris sacra vulgasset, Lege morti addicebatur: Τὸν ἐξειπόντα τὰ Μυστήρια πεθήναι[?] Qui Mysteria vulgarit, capite luat.

Meminit huius Legis Sopater in Diuisione Quaestionis, nosque ex eo descripsimus, [illegible, ~30 letters], aliunde namque nobis constat capitale fuisse Athenis vulgare haec initia: Ea quippe de causa proscriptus fuit ab Athenien-sibus Diagoras Melius, ac propositum talentum vnum eiusqui Diagoram interfecisset, duo, qui viuum adduxisset. Interpres Comici ad Aues, & ex eo Suidas: [illegible, ~70 letters]

Etiam Æschylus in vitae discrimen venit, cum in Tragoediis nonnulla, quaeque initia spectabant, euulgasse credderetur. Clemens Alexandrinus Stromat. II. [illegible, ~50 letters] Eustrathius in cap.I. Libri III. Ethicor. Nicomach. [illegible, ~120 letters] Pollux Lib. VIII. c.XII. [illegible, ~60 letters]

Haec tamen Mysteria vocat Ἀναχαλυπτήρια[?], Synesius in Calvitiei encomio: nam vbi nonnulla de frugibus obseruauit, addit, [illegible, ~40 letters]. Putat Cl Meursius Synesium ludentem, quae Mysteria alij, Anakalyptheia dixisse, in quibus nempe Cereris acta reuelarentur. Nuperus Synesii Interpres causam appellationis hanc esse exististimat, quod in Cereris prodeuntis, atq; è gluma & inuolucris explicitae, ac retectae, honore celebrarentur: Nam postea caluorum capita effluentibus pilis [illegible, ~25 letters], ait, ob idq; eorum Anakalyptheia celebrata. Ad hoc pertinere videntur Ouidiani illis versus X. Metam. Festa piae Cereris celebrabant orgia matres, illa, quibus nivea velatae corpora veste,

page.notes: Scan is blurred and faded, especially the Greek passages, which are marked illegible where I could not read them letter by letter. The Greek title words in the Synesius and Clemens passages are doubtful. The page number may read 33 or 35. The mark at the lower right is uncertain and may be a signature or a stray mark. Printed "viuum", "vnum", "niuea" and "euulgasse" are given with corrected u/v as the rules require.
